title: Honeyed Argentinian Cheese Empanadas
description: Sweet, aerated empanadas filled with creamy cheese and glazed with honey, perfect for a cozy treat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C and grease a baking sheet.
In a large bowl, combine flour and salt.
Gradually whisk in warm water and melted butter until dough forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, then cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a 6-inch circle.
Place 30 g of cheese slices and a drizzle of honey on half of each circle, fold over, and seal edges with a fork.
Brush empanadas with beaten egg and arrange on the sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown, then cool slightly before serving.
